Marshall & Dominguez LLP
Pearland, TX

Letter of Representation
April 19, 2025
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1208
Our client: Emily Baker
Date of loss: March 26, 2025
Dear Claims Representative:
This firm rperesents our client in connection with a collision that occurred in a parking lot and resulted in significant
personal injuries to our client. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not
contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your
company has already spoken with our client, please note that we expect all future contact to pass through this firm.
We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, together with a
certified copy of the declarations page and any applicable umbrella or excess coverage that may apply. Please
confirm in writing within fourteen days of receiving this letter.
We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash
camera or surveillance footage, vehicle data, adjuster notes, recorded statements, repair estimates, and any other
documents or electronic records in your possession or control. Destroying or altering any of this material could
expose your company to serious legal consequences.
We look forward to your prompt response.
Sincerely,
Kyle Sanders
Marshall & Dominguez LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
